create_panda_sim_instance: create a PandaSim instance with a bullet client and offset to load the panda robot and scene objects
step_panda_sim: step the PandaSim simulation to compute inverse kinematics and apply position control to panda joints
reset_panda_sim: reset the PandaSim simulation state by calling the reset method on the PandaSim instance
review_panda_sim_init: review the PandaSim __init__ method that loads URDF models and configures joint states for the panda robot
refactor_panda_sim_step: refactor the PandaSim step method to support custom end effector trajectories instead of hardcoded sinusoidal motion
